title: Return of scheme lines at the desk: RT4 returns 12 of 24 Glucose (12+2 free) and 6 of 12 soap (10% off)

steps.text: what the shop was billed for those pieces (taxable, pro rata)
free pieces the shop keeps after returning half the qualifying pieces (see corrected observation: the credit is pro rata over paid + free pieces)
return of every remaining Glucose piece incl. the free ones

observations: CORRECTED on review: the credit note does not credit at the paid rate. CN/9008 credits Glucose at ₹6.38 a piece = the line taxable ₹178.56 spread over the 28 pieces delivered (24 paid + 4 free), so 12 returned pieces are credited 12/28 of the line (₹76.52 taxable), which claws the free goods back pro rata. The earlier note ("keeps all 4 free pieces, credited at the full paid rate") was a misreading and is withdrawn.

checks.name: soap credited at the billed (10%-off) rate, not list (DOS-242)
credit for the remaining pieces never exceeds what the shop still paid for on that line
checks.detail: credited 12000 vs 12040 left on the line
